parsed.text: Two panels (p0, p1) give fallible 4x4 location distributions for red and blue at nodes n0–n3 on the stated coordinate system. Current estimates: in both panels node n0 has a very strong blue peak at (0,1) and a very strong red peak at (0,3); nodes n1 and n2 are uniform across the grid; node n3 differs by panel: p0 current has both roles peaked at (1,2) with moderate-to-high peak probabilities, while p1 current is uniform at n3. Origins and timing are recorded with each distribution: copied prior records and inherited/current origins are not new estimates; conditional command records (candidate views labeled k0,k1,k2 and native_conditional records) are conditional estimates, not executed events. Across conditional commands the consistent facts are the strong peaks at n0 and the uniform n1/n2; node n3 varies by command and panel (candidate records show different peak locations and peak probabilities, e.g. some candidates place blue strongly at (1,2) while others spread probability or place red peaks elsewhere).
